purpose: silver_runways cleans the bronze ourairports_runways capture into a typed runway reference table, one row per runway record identified by id, feeding downstream airport infrastructure and routing analyses.
usage: Join on airport_ref to the airports dimension and use le_ident/he_ident for runway-end labels; treat lighted and closed as boolean flags, and expect nulls in geospatial and displaced-threshold columns to be retained rather than imputed.
limitations: Latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns carry null rates between roughly 22% and 28% (e.g. le_latitude_deg 0.220911, he_elevation_ft 0.276208), and displaced-threshold columns are null for 88-90% of rows (le_displaced_threshold_ft 0.884201, he_displaced_threshold_ft 0.899907); no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
